test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All motors are ships.

Some ships are bowls.

No ship is a hammer.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some motors are hammers.

(II) Some bowls are motors.

(III) Some bowls are not hammers.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows
All the conclusions I, II and III follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4011cff0d58a65754abde889719be830d801cb10a130f6c751aa3214cc69b6e8.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some motors are hammers → **False** (All motors are ships, and no ship is hammer implies that no motor is hammer).

(II) Some bowls are motors → **False** (All motors are ships, and some ships are bowls implies that some bowls can be motors. This is possible but not definite).

(III) Some bowls are not hammers → **True** (All motors are ships, some ships are bowls, and no ship is a hammer implies that some bowls which are ships are not hammer).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion III follows"**.
